description: XINGLIGHT XL-1615RGBC-RF four-pad common-anode RGB LED
name: xl-1615rgbc-rf

provenance.source: manufacturer-datasheet; nominal body model from JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library

watch_out_for: Two XINGLIGHT figures label the same physical color positions with different numbers. DigiKey-hosted manufacturer PDF p8 (view as drawn, marking at left) places R top-left, common bottom-left, G top-right, B bottom-right and labels these 1,2,3,4 respectively. Supplier-linked XINGLIGHT 2019 A4 p2 places those same colors there but labels them 1,3,2,4. JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library supplier CAD uses a 180-degree rotation: R bottom-right=1, common top-right=2, B top-left=3, G bottom-left=4; this bundle follows that CAD numbering and rotation, not the later PDF's pin numbers. CAD source: https://easyeda.com/api/products/C965840/components?version=6.4.19, JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library https://lceda.cn/ and https://easyeda.com/. Supplier-linked A4 PDF: https://atta.szlcsc.com/upload/public/pdf/source/20201230/C965840_8C3C6189FA91F090C0C29FA2A5E3FA85.pdf. Later PDF p8 recommends 0.45 x 0.65 mm lands, 1.25 mm horizontal center pitch, 0.30 mm vertical land gap (0.95 mm pitch); this bundle uses exactly that pattern. The A4 figure recommends the same land sizes and horizontal pitch but 0.20 mm land gap (0.85 mm pitch). These are land gaps, not body-terminal gaps: the later body drawing has 0.55 mm terminals with 0.40 mm vertical gap; A4 has 0.60 mm terminals on a 1.5 mm body (0.30 mm gap). In nominal body-centered coordinates, these copper lands span x=0.40..0.85 and y=0.15..0.80 mm per quadrant; later terminals span x=0.47..0.80, y=0.20..0.75 and A4 terminals x=0.45..0.80, y=0.15..0.75. Both fit nominally, but placement, manufacturing and general drawing tolerances (later +/-0.25 mm; A4 +/-0.10 mm unless otherwise noted) require assembly review; these dimensions do not guarantee a solder joint. Later PDF pp3-4 specifies 20 mA continuous per color and 80 mA peak; Vf ranges are specified at 20 mA, not at 2 mA. Light output at circuit current is unmeasured.
